name: Genome Understanding Evaluation (GUE)
description: GUE is a comprehensive multi-species genome classification benchmark that amalgamates 36 distinct datasets across 9 tasks, with input lengths ranging from 70 to 10,000. It is designed to enable fair comparative analysis of genome understanding models.
reputation: A recent genomics benchmark that is useful for comparative evaluation, but it is still emerging rather than a widely standardized community benchmark.
notes: Benchmark created alongside DNABERT-2 model; covers multiple species and tasks; addresses lack of standardized genome understanding benchmark.
